message: Not_applicable verifier decisions vld-xi2f29-012 through vld-xi2f29-017 use proof_seed_id: PS-xi2f29-001 and requirement_id: ALL as a catch-all. Per proof-schemas.md, each (requirement_id, contract_clause, proof_seed_id) tuple needs one lane decision per verifier. Proof seeds PS-xi2f29-002 through PS-xi2f29-012 lack explicit per-seed not_applicable decisions for tla-plus, verus, flux-rs, loom, miri, cargo-fuzz. The rationale (pure single-threaded hash computation) is identically applicable to all seeds. Not a blocker for P1; the implicit coverage is self-evident.
required_fix: Either (a) expand not_applicable rows to reference all 12 proof seed IDs, or (b) add explicit per-seed not_applicable rows for PS-002 through PS-012 covering tla-plus, verus, flux-rs, loom, miri, cargo-fuzz. The latter provides better traceability.

message: PO-xi2f29-007 target field is 'all_existing_proptest_tests' which describes a test file, not a specific test harness. The command 'cargo test -p vb_compile --test v1_primitive_lowering -- --nocapture' runs all tests in that file. This is operationally correct but the virtual target name complicates automated traceability.
required_fix: Consider specifying the concrete test names in the target field or adding an explicit note that the obligation gates the full test suite. Not a blocker.
